name: codex-ocapn-correspondence
description: Maps the 18 OCapN/CapTP/E-rights patterns reinvented piecemeal across codex-rs to their canonical Spritely/Goblins equivalents and the hermes-* bridge skills that formalize each correspondence. Use when auditing capability architecture in codex-rs, planning a Hoot/Goblins port, or reasoning about which E-rights primitive a codex-rs module implicitly implements.
